latest_features: Hotfix: corrected shulker preview shared-header SDK include paths for the in-tree shulker_view integration so Windows release builds compile
ShulkerPreview now reads hovered shulker item NBT directly so the preview grid reflects real stored contents instead of relying on heuristic text parsing
HUD inventory view adds an extra 2x scale boost and centers item icons/counts cleanly inside each table slot
Minimap storage markers now classify droppers and dispensers as their own tracked block types instead of collapsing them into mixed storage
